description.narrative: Means of verification for result area 3 are reported mostly in TS4FNS5 because this result has been redefined in a food systems perspective in 2020. JRC report here only the results related specifically to TS4FNS4.

comment.narrative: AR1 Study on mapping Cocoa in West African by using Copernicus data funded on TS4FNS4 budget.AR2 In 2021 two additional rounds in Kenya of the telephone survey launched in 2020 to study the impacts of multiple stressors on small scale agriculture in the main agricultural production areas were carried out one of the two was funded by TS4FNS4 and one by JRC institutional.Joint reports with other organisationsAR3.2 Joint report with IIED Democratizing earth observation to improve transparency in unregulated land use change drafted mostly in 2020 has been reviewed and finalized in 2021 The report is available in English and in French on the LandCam websitehttpswww.landcam.orgendemocratizingearthobservationimprovetransparencylandusegovernance.Country fact sheets on the SAFNSAR3.4 Bimonthly steering committee which includes the MoA of Senegal EU Delegation for the followingup of the expost assessment of the input subsidy programme
